title: Fix Table Page Breaks in Mit Bestand Zwischenbericht
description: mit bestand zwischenbericht: The page breaks of some tables e.g. Akteursnetz are not working correctly. Rows of long tables (e.g. Tabelle AN.2.a:3 Frankreich) run past the bottom of the page frame into the footer instead of breaking onto the next page.
summary: GraphSpread ended with a group-local \restoregeometry, leaving the spread's taller global \@colht behind; longtable's output routine never resets it, so the Frankreich table opening right after the Akteursnetz figure spread overflowed the frame on pages 103-106. \semio_graph_spread_end: now re-seats \@colht, \@colroom and \vsize globally. Verified by rebuilding the Zwischenbericht and measuring every page. Manual bookkeeping (ticket_open returned a malformed result). Report: 📓️report.md.
